items: Main bearings and connecting rod bearings — replaced as standard during every AJ150 rebuild. [Photograph of bearings]
Complete gasket and seal set — every seal and gasket is replaced during a rebuild. [Photograph of gaskets]

Turbocharger — inspected for wear and performance. [Photograph of turbocharger]
